items.t: West Central, Maple Ridge: 58 houses sold at a median of $1,045,000, with the middle half between $936,250 and $1,193,750. The median house took 20 days to sell and closed at 96.3% of list.

38 townhomes sold in West Central, Maple Ridge at a median of $615,000 (middle half $526,250 to $674,500). A typical townhome in West Central, Maple Ridge spent 42 days on the market and closed at 97.7% of the asking price.
In West Central, Maple Ridge, condos sold at a median of $445,950 across 98 sales, and the middle half closed between $390,000 and $515,000. The median condo sat 26 days and sold for 97.7% of list.

blocks.text: 4 Duplexes also sold in West Central, Maple Ridge, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How West Central compares with the rest of Maple Ridge

items.t: Of 9 Maple Ridge sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, West Central ranks 7th highest at $1,045,000; the range is $1,039,000 (Southwest Maple Ridge) to $1,421,500 (Silver Valley). Websters Corners ($1,042,500) sits just below and East Central ($1,100,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in West Central have the second lowest median of 8 Maple Ridge sub-areas, $615,000. Southwest Maple Ridge is lowest at $610,000 and Thornhill highest at $862,000. Southwest Maple Ridge ($610,000) sits just below and Northwest Maple Ridge ($640,000) sits just above.
Condos in West Central have the lowest median of the 3 Maple Ridge sub-areas, $445,950, below Northwest Maple Ridge at $481,500; the highest is East Central at $482,500.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in West Central, Maple Ridge (median 2015) and houses the oldest (median 1972), a gap of 43 years.
